text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day in February—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur... murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...? There's quite a crowd. It's not meal 
serving time yet, is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Bu~no! Is everyone here? Seems like there 
are more people than planned, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The more, the merrier, right! All right, 
everyone, let's head to the kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Why am I making chocolates?!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I was mistaken for one of the 
participants by chance and got swept up 
into joining, but if it's a mistake I 
should say so—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Hayahide-san, you're so good at 
tempering! Your diligence transforms right 
into deliciousness, buono~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh. Th... Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!? / Kyaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Craaash!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! Are you hurt!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then that's a relief. Was it just the bowl 
that dropped? We can still turn this 
around. Here, don't panic.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why did I end up participating until the 
very end...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, we're about to train, you know? 
What's the point of loading yourself down 
with unnecessary baggage?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I had bought separate chocolates 
for Trainer-kun. If I were to give him 
handmade ones instead—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm overthinking this. If I have 
two of them on hand, I can just give them 
both, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I'm counting on you today as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, full of energy as always, aren't 
you? To show my gratitude for everything 
you do—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-Nothing's wrong! Nothing weird is 
going on at all!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
T-Today is Valentine's Day, right?! So I 
thought I'd give you some chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's, Trainer-kun!! Thank you 
for always training me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do our best today too! 
Time to start warming up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Biwa Hayahide was acting a little 
strange, but the chocolate she gave me was 
very delicious.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh... Hmm... Well, you see. First, 
let me start with a preface.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. After evolving 
through various intentions and history, it 
has become a day to express not only 
romantic feelings, but also friendship and 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, taking advantage of this event 
to express daily gratitude in the visible 
form of chocolate presents no issues 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I have prepared something as 
well. It's chocolate I purchased at a 
department store the other day."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, it is too early to thank me. As an 
exception this time, I was also tasked 
with preparing this chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Um... It's homemade chocolate.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want both?
Are you sure you want both?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's fine. It's only fitting as 
gratitude to you. In fact, it's hardly 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was made on a whim, but it seems to 
have turned out quite well. Please, have a 
taste.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...If it suited your palate as well, I 
shall put even more effort into the 
homemade ones next time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of Biwa Hayahide's chocolates were 
delicious, ...and the handmade one tasted 
especially sweet.
